Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao
Bench: U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Criminal Petition No.5348 Of 2019
Order:

The petitioner/accused seeks to quash the proceedings against him in Crime No.179 of 2017 of Vinukonda Town Police Station, Guntur District, which was registered against him for the offences under Sections 270, 273, 284 of IPC and Sec.58, 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'FSS Act, 2006).

entities.text: Vinukonda Town Police Station, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. The allegations against the petitioner briefly are that on 23.07.2017 at 11:30 P.M., on credible information, the complainant along with his staff rushed to Ambika Nagar, Vinukonda Town,
arrested the accused who was in possession of banned tobacco products, seized the same from him,
and registered a case in Crime No.179 of 2017 for the offences stated supra.
3.

Learned counsel for petitioners while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, tobacco products would not fall within the definition of Section 3(j) of FSS Act and therefore, the Police are not authorized to register the crime, investigate and file charge sheet and therefore, registration of the FIR is contrary to the provisions of FSS Act.
He relied upon the order of this Court in Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 & batch, dated 27.08.2018.
As can be seen, in the said common order a learned Judge of this Court partly allowed the criminal petitions and quashed the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act.

4. Following the above order and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings initiated against the petitioners under Sections 270, 273, 284 of IPC and Secs.58, 63, of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, Interlocutory Applications pending, if any, in this case shall stand closed.
MS HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE U. DURGA PRASAD RAO CRIMINAL PETITION No.5348 OF 2019 Date
